traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills are initially pale but become purplish-brown to almost black as the spores mature. They are crowded and often have a slightly jagged edge.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills are initially pale but become purplish-brown to almost black as the spores mature. They are crowded and often have a slightly jagged edge.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: conic to convex or flat, often with a slightly upturned, ragged edge when mature. It's thin-fleshed, hygrophanous, and can be pale brown when moist, drying to a lighter color, almost straw-yellow or pale grayish.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: conic to convex or flat, often with a slightly upturned, ragged edge when mature. It's thin-fleshed, hygrophanous, and can be pale brown when moist, drying to a lighter color, almost straw-yellow or pale grayish.

traits.text: adnate to adnexed.
